content.value_statement: Detailed AI context files are often too long for quick human review. This skill turns them into summaries, quick starts, and Mermaid visual guides.
actual_capabilities: Reads AI documentation in the ai folder and creates matching docs folder outputs.
Produces summary documents with executive summaries, key points, and quick reference tables.
Produces quick start guides with steps, prerequisites, verification, and troubleshooting sections.
Creates Mermaid visual guides for architecture, flows, sequences, schemas, and states.
Updates existing human documentation when source AI documents change.
Creates docs README navigation for generated human documentation.
limitations: Requires existing AI documentation with enough detail to summarize accurately.
Does not create domain specifications from scratch.
Mermaid diagrams should be reviewed for accuracy before publishing.
Manual additions need clear markers if they should be preserved during updates.

use_cases.title: Onboard Developers
use_cases.description: Create summaries and visual guides so new engineers can understand architecture without reading every AI context file.

use_cases.title: Brief Executives
use_cases.description: Convert detailed technical specifications into concise summaries and diagrams for planning and review meetings.

use_cases.title: Support Implementation
use_cases.description: Create quick start guides that help developers follow key workflows, verify setup, and find related source documents.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one concise document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a human-readable summary for ai/architect/app/02_BACKEND_REQUIREMENTS.md and save it in the matching docs folder.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Quick Start
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for an action-focused guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-minute quick start from ai/architect/app/05_CSV_UPLOAD_SPECIFICATION.md with prerequisites, steps, verification, and common issues.

prompt_templates.title: Create Visual Guides
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Mermaid diagrams for ai/architect/app/07_WORKFLOWS_AND_DATA_FLOW.md, including overview, data flow, and component interaction diagrams.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Refresh Documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a folder-level update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refresh all human docs for ai/architect/app/, preserve marked manual additions, and regenerate docs/README.md navigation.

output_examples.input: Create a summary for a long backend requirements document.
output_examples.output: A shorter summary document with an executive overview, key points, quick reference table, and links to the source document.

output_examples.input: Create diagrams for a data flow document.
output_examples.output: A visual guide with Mermaid diagrams for system overview, data movement, component interaction, and state changes.

output_examples.input: Update human docs after AI documentation changed.
output_examples.output: Updated docs that reflect the current source material while preserving clearly marked manual notes.

best_practices: Keep detailed AI context files as the source of truth.
Review generated summaries and diagrams before sharing them with stakeholders.
Use consistent file names so docs outputs mirror the ai folder structure.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to replace detailed AI context documentation.
Do not generate diagrams from unclear source material without review.
Do not manually edit generated docs without updating the source AI document.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates summaries, quick starts, and Mermaid visual guides from detailed AI context documentation.

faq.question: Does it modify the ai folder?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructions say the ai folder remains the source of truth and should only be read.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: Generated files are saved in a matching docs folder structure with clear suffixes for each format.

faq.question: Can it update existing human docs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare updated AI documentation with existing docs and regenerate human-readable outputs.

faq.question: Does it support diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Mermaid syntax for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, entity diagrams, state diagrams, and timelines.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Developers, engineering leads, product teams, and business stakeholders who need shorter technical documentation can use it.
